interpretation.inference: Each contrast/window CP bound has conservative >=95% coverage before multiple-comparison selection; no simultaneous family guarantee.
interpretation.cost: Within both_success, ratio is sum(candidate bytes)/sum(reference bytes), equivalently ratio of the two means over exactly the same successful pairs. It is not mean per-case ratio, nor an unconditional efficiency effect.
interpretation.curve: Empirical complete success AND observed successful payload bytes <= threshold from unbounded runs. Monotonicity and infinity endpoint verified. Excludes setup/metadata and failed-transfer wire overhead; no hard-cap executor or hard-cap service guarantee.
interpretation.generalization: Post-hoc development evidence on six previously inspected windows; no unseen-data, novelty, or causal mechanism confirmation.
interpretation.timing: Elapsed times were neither evaluated nor compared.
